heading: Short title, extent and commencement
title: Short title, extent and commencement
text:
1. Short title, extent and commencement.—(1) This Act may be called the Professions Tax Limitation Act, 1941.
(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

heading: Limitation of tax on professions, etc
title: Limitation of tax on professions, etc
text: 2. Limitation of tax on professions, etc.—(1) Notwithstanding the provisions of any law a High Court and the Supreme Court, the tax on professions, trades, callings or employments levied and collected under an Act of a Provincial Assembly on or after the 1st day of July, 1977, as is not in excess of the limit fixed in sub-section (1), shall be deemed to have been validly levied and collected and shall not be liable to be refunded and the provisions of this Act shall have, and shall be deemed always to have had, effect accordingly.
raw_text:
4[2. Limitation of tax on professions, etc.—(1) Notwithstanding the provisions of any law 
for the time being in force, a Provincial Assembly may by an Act impose tax not exceeding one 
hundered thousand rupees on persons engaged in professions, trades, callings or employments. 
(2) Notwithstanding anything contained in any law or in any judgment of any court including 
a High Court and the Supreme Court, the tax on professions, trades, callings or employments levied 
and collected under an Act of a Provincial Assembly on or after the 1st day of July, 1977, as is not in 
excess of the limit fixed in sub-section (1), shall be deemed to have been validly levied and collected 
and shall not be liable to be refunded and the provisions of this Act shall have, and shall be deemed 
always to have had, effect accordingly.]

title: 1For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gazette of India, 1941, Pt
text:
1949.

1For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gazette of India, 1941, Pt. V, p. 123, and for Report of Select Committee, see ibid., p. 167.
The Act has been applied to Balochistan, see Notification No. 52-F, dated the 5th April, 1942, Gazette of India, 1942, Pt. I, p. 682.
It has been extended to the Leased Areas of Balochistan by the Leased Areas (Laws) Order, 1950 (G. G. O. 3 of 1950).
2Subs. by Act 4 of 1999, s. 2.
3Subs. by the Central Laws (Statute Reform) Ordinance, 1960 (21 of 1960), s. 3 and 2nd Sch. (with effect from the 14th October, 1955), for the original sub-section (2), as amended by A. O., 1949.
4Subs. by Act III of 06, s. 3 and shall be deemed to have been so, subs. on 1st July, 1977.
